en.headline: Three substances to be listed under Dangerous Drugs Ordinance
en.dek: The Security Bureau said the amending order would be gazetted on Friday, tabled in LegCo on 7 October and take effect on 27 November.
body: The Security Bureau said on 30 September that the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance (Amendment of First Schedule) Order 2026 would be published in the Gazette on Friday, 2 October.

The order adds three substances to the First Schedule: N-pyrrolidino isotonitazene, N-desethyl etonitazene and MDMB-FUBINACA. The bureau said the change follows international control requirements and is meant to tighten safeguards against trafficking and abuse.

The order is to be tabled in the Legislative Council on 7 October for negative vetting and is expected to take effect on 27 November. The bureau said trafficking or manufacturing the substances would carry a maximum penalty of life imprisonment and a HK$5 million fine, while possession or consumption in breach of the ordinance would carry a maximum of seven years' imprisonment and a HK$1 million fine.

zh.headline: 三款物質納入危險藥物條例 周五刊憲
zh.dek: 保安局表示修訂令周五刊登憲報，十月七日提交立法會先訂立後審議，預計十一月二十七日生效。
body: 保安局九月三十日表示，《2026年危險藥物條例（修訂附表1）令》會在星期五（十月二日）刊登憲報。
修訂令把三種物質加入附表1，分別是N-pyrrolidino isotonitazene、N-desethyl etonitazene，以及MDMB-FUBINACA。保安局指，修訂配合國際管制要求，旨在加強防範這些危險藥物被販運或濫用。
修訂令將於十月七日提交立法會，以先訂立後審議的方式處理，預計十一月二十七日生效。保安局表示，販運或製造這些物質，最高可判終身監禁及罰款500萬元；違反條例管有或服用，最高可判監禁七年及罰款100萬元。
